name: Firmus Project Southgate Stage 1 (Launceston AI Factory)

address.value: 23 Killafaddy Road and part of 66-92 St Leonards Road, St Leonards
address.note: approx. 5 ha and 13 ha lots respectively

postcode.note: St Leonards TAS believed 7250; not confirmed from a source

lat.note: not geocoded: WebFetch/geocoder blocked in this session

developer.note: DA prepared by pitt&sherry on behalf of Firmus

mw_it.note: Stage 1 combined: Stage 1a 44 MW + Stage 1b to 90 MW; Stage 2 (~300 MW) separate/not approved

mw_grid.note: 104 MW Hydro Tasmania supply via Aurora Energy three-year deal; ABC Jun 2026 also cites St Leonards as 104 MW

cost_aud_m.note: AUD 2.1bn; described variously as Stage 1a or Stage 1 investment

pathway.note: endorsed at a Special Council Meeting

determined.note: Special Council Meeting 1 Sep 2025; one summary said 'July', likely confusing with Jul 2025 project announcement

jobs_construction.note: Firmus spokesperson (The Examiner, ~Mar 2026): about 80 workers on site, rising to 400 at peak

jobs_construction_other.note: The Examiner: 'more than 1,000' workers in total including off-site contractors (lower bound)

jobs_operational.note: DCD/w.media: 'up to 100 direct jobs' in the first stage

construction_start.note: started after Sep 2025 approval; earthworks complete and piling under way by ~Mar 2026 (source 3)

construction_end.note: expected; ABC Jun 2026 says operational early 2027 (originally targeted mid/end 2026)

open_questions: Stage 1a/1b could be split into separate rows
